parsed.note_claim: A child's genes come from the sperm and egg that achieve fertilization; previous partners make no genetic contribution.

parsed.quote: During fertilization, when the egg and sperm join, the two sets of chromosomes come together. In this way, one half of a baby’s genes come from the baby’s mother and one half come from the baby’s father.
